text:
Sam (CEO): Quick Northstar sync — TL;DR: one policy tweak, one launch callout, and a short incident note. Please read and react. :eyes:

Sam (CEO): Priorities for the week:
- Keep EU Private beta scheduled for 03/31, marketing + infra readiness on track.
- Push cost-per-token target down 8% by end of month (Optimize recommendations -> apply at least two).
- Finalize data retention policy changes for Dedicated/Private (see ask below).

Sam (CEO): Metrics snapshot (this morning): p95 gen latency @ 180ms (hosted), error rate 0.9% (down from 1.4%), unit cost -3% vs last week.

Leah (VP Ops): Noted on retention policy. Can we set the timeline? Legal asked for 30-day default + opt-in 90-day on Dedicated.

Priya (Product): I can own comms for the EU beta. Draft landing + release notes by Tue EOD. Need final copy of SLAs we commit to. @Leah can you confirm SLA numbers? :memo:

Leah (VP Ops): SLA targets: 99.9% monthly uptime for Dedicated pools in beta, 99.8% for hosted EU region. Will confirm in writing by Tue morning.

Diego (Eng): For the cost target — we'll flip two quantization profiles and enable prefix cache for the 512-token hot-path on dev next 48h. Expect ~6% cost save from that alone.

Sam (CEO): Nice — Diego, please coordinate with @Priya so perf claims match marketing. Also, let's add a brief note in the EU beta announcement about expected latency ranges.

Priya (Product): Will do. Quick Q: rollback plan if we see latency regressions after quantized rollout?

Diego (Eng): Canary + auto-fallback to float model variant in the serving router. I'll add fallback metrics to the console (ops dashboard).

Sam (CEO): Incident recap (Friday P0): autoscaler mis-sizing caused short tail latency spikes for a subset of dedicated pools — root cause: incorrect instance warmup threshold. Fix rolled Friday night, retro planned Wed.

Leah (VP Ops): Retro invite sent for Wed 10:30 PT, recording + notes will be posted. Action items: update warmup threshold + add a synthetic smoke test.

Sam (CEO): Policy ask: Legal wants the retention change announced 2 weeks before rollout, with an opt-in form for longer retention. Decision: greenlight, Leah to coordinate legal + product for announcement timeline.

Leah (VP Ops): Copy. I'll draft announcement by Monday and loop in Legal.

DeployBot: Deployment completed: service/redwood-serving v3.14 -> v3.15 (canary 100%). No errors reported.

Sam (CEO): Final asks: react with :thumbsup: if you're aligned, add items to the action tracker, and ping me if anything blocks EU beta. Meeting cadence: skip next week's full exec; micro-sync Thurs 09:00 PT if needed.

Priya (Product): :thumbsup: I'll add comms tasks to the tracker.

Diego (Eng): :thumbsup: starting quantization canary tonight.

Leah (VP Ops): :thumbsup: legal looped in, announcement draft Monday.
